items.title: Local SEO
items.summary: Rank higher for the searches that actually bring customers through the door.
items.overview: Local SEO is about showing up when someone nearby searches for what you do — not ranking for keywords that look impressive but never convert. We focus on the searches that lead to calls, bookings, and footfall.
benefits: Higher visibility in local search results and Google Maps
More enquiries from people already looking to buy
A clearer picture of which searches actually bring in customers
whatsIncluded: On-page optimisation for local search terms

process.title: Audit
process.description: We start by finding out where you currently rank, what's broken technically, and what your competitors are doing better.

process.title: Build
process.description: On-page fixes, content, and citations are put in place, prioritised by what will move the needle fastest.

process.title: Track
process.description: Rankings and traffic are monitored monthly, with the plan adjusted as your market and competitors change.

faqs.question: How long does Local SEO take to show results?
faqs.answer: Most businesses start seeing movement within 8–12 weeks, though this depends on how competitive your market is and what state your current site is in.

faqs.question: Do I need a new website for Local SEO to work?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily — we'll tell you honestly if your existing site is holding you back, but a lot of the work can be done regardless.

items.title: Google Business Profile Optimisation
items.summary: Turn your Google listing into your strongest source of new enquiries.
items.overview: Your Google Business Profile is often the first thing a potential customer sees — before your website, before anything else. We make sure it's complete, accurate, and actively working for you, not just sitting there half-filled-in.
benefits: Better visibility in the Google Maps 'local pack'
A profile that answers customer questions before they even call
More clicks, calls, and direction requests

process.title: Review
process.description: We check what's currently set up, what's missing, and what's actively working against you.

process.title: Optimise
process.description: Categories, services, descriptions, and photos are all brought up to a standard that actually converts.

process.title: Maintain
process.description: Ongoing posts, updates, and review responses keep the profile active — Google rewards profiles that stay current.

faqs.question: Can you manage my Google Business Profile if I already have one?
faqs.answer: Yes — most of our work is improving existing profiles rather than starting from scratch.

faqs.question: Do you respond to reviews for me?
faqs.answer: We can, depending on your plan — either drafting responses for your approval or handling it directly.

items.title: Website Design
items.summary: A site built to convert, not just to look good in a portfolio.
items.overview: A website that looks nice but doesn't generate enquiries isn't doing its job. We design sites around what a visitor actually needs to see to pick up the phone or fill in a form — built properly, not from a generic template.
benefits: A site built around your actual customers, not a stock template
Fast, mobile-first, and built to convert
Easy for you to update yourself, no developer needed
whatsIncluded: Custom design based on your business and market
Content management system so you can edit it yourself

process.title: Plan
process.description: We work out what the site actually needs to do for your business before any design starts.

process.title: Design & build
process.description: A site designed around your business, built properly rather than assembled from a generic template.

process.title: Launch & train
process.description: Once it's live, we show you how to update it yourself — no waiting on a developer for small changes.

faqs.question: Can I update the website myself once it's live?
faqs.answer: Yes — every site we build comes with a content management system so you can edit text, images, and pages without touching code.

faqs.question: How long does a new website take?
faqs.answer: Typically 4–6 weeks from approved design to launch, depending on how much content needs writing.

items.title: Branding
items.summary: A visual identity that looks right everywhere it appears — from your van to your invoices.
items.overview: Branding is more than a logo — it's the consistent look and feel that makes your business recognisable and trustworthy wherever it shows up: your website, your van, your invoices, your Google listing.
benefits: A consistent, professional look across every touchpoint
A brand that reflects the quality of the work you actually do
Assets you can hand to any printer, supplier, or platform without a headache
whatsIncluded: Core templates — business cards, social, signage-ready files

process.title: Discover
process.description: We learn about your business, your customers, and what you want people to think when they see your name.

process.title: Design
process.description: Logo, colours, and typography developed and refined with your input.

process.title: Document
process.description: Everything is delivered in a brand guideline pack so it stays consistent wherever it's used.

faqs.question: Do I need new branding if I already have a logo?
faqs.answer: Not always — sometimes it's a case of tightening up what you have rather than starting over. We'll be honest about which one you need.

faqs.question: What files will I actually receive?
faqs.answer: Every format you'd realistically need — print-ready, web-ready, and source files — with no dependency on us to reuse them.

items.title: Google Ads Management
items.summary: Ad spend managed properly, with reporting that shows exactly where it went.
items.overview: Google Ads can work extremely well for local businesses, or burn through budget fast if it's not managed properly. We build and manage campaigns aimed at enquiries, not just clicks, with reporting that shows exactly what your budget achieved.
benefits: Campaigns targeted at people ready to buy, not just browsing
Full visibility into where every pound of ad spend goes
Ongoing optimisation instead of a campaign set up once and left alone
whatsIncluded: Ad creation and landing page recommendations

process.title: Set up
process.description: Campaigns are built around the searches most likely to convert for your specific business, not generic keywords.

process.title: Launch
process.description: Conversion tracking goes in first, so from day one we know what's actually working.

process.title: Optimise
process.description: Budgets, keywords, and ads are adjusted monthly based on real performance data, not guesswork.

faqs.question: What's the minimum ad budget you'd recommend?
faqs.answer: It depends on your market and competition — we'll give you a realistic number during the strategy call rather than a generic figure.

faqs.question: Is the management fee separate from ad spend?
faqs.answer: Yes — our fee covers strategy and management; your ad budget goes directly to Google.

items.title: AI Marketing Solutions
items.summary: Practical AI tools that save time on the repetitive parts of marketing.
items.overview: Most 'AI marketing' talk is hype. What we actually do is use AI where it removes genuinely repetitive work — drafting content variations, summarising performance data, speeding up research — so more time goes into the strategic decisions that need a person.
benefits: Time saved on repetitive content and reporting tasks
Faster turnaround without sacrificing quality control
AI used as a tool, not a replacement for judgement
whatsIncluded: Workflow recommendations specific to your business
Ongoing tool selection as the landscape changes

process.title: Identify
process.description: We look at where repetitive work is actually costing you time, rather than adding AI for its own sake.

process.title: Implement
process.description: Tools are set up and tested against your actual content and workflows.

process.title: Review
process.description: Everything AI produces gets a human check before it goes anywhere near a customer.

faqs.question: Will AI-written content sound generic?
faqs.answer: Not if it's reviewed properly — which is exactly why nothing goes out without a human pass first.

faqs.question: Do you use AI to replace strategy work?
faqs.answer: No — AI handles repetitive execution; strategy and judgement stay with a person.

items.title: AI Google Review Automation
items.summary: Automatic, on-brand follow-up that gets more of your happy customers leaving reviews.
items.overview: Most happy customers never leave a review, not because they don't want to, but because nobody asked them at the right time. We set up automatic, on-brand follow-up that asks at the right moment — without sounding like a robot.
benefits: More reviews from customers who were already happy
Follow-up that happens automatically, with no manual chasing
Requests and responses that sound like your business, not a template
whatsIncluded: On-brand messaging tailored to your business
Negative feedback routed privately before it becomes a public review
Monthly reporting on review volume and rating

process.title: Set up
process.description: Follow-up messaging is written in your voice and connected to however you currently manage customers.

process.title: Automate
process.description: Requests go out automatically at the right moment after a job or purchase — no manual chasing.

process.title: Monitor
process.description: Volume and sentiment are tracked monthly, with negative feedback flagged privately first.

faqs.question: Will this feel like spam to my customers?
faqs.answer: No — requests are timed and worded to feel like a genuine follow-up, not a mass blast.

faqs.question: What happens if a customer leaves negative feedback?
faqs.answer: It's routed to you privately first, so you can resolve it before it potentially becomes a public review.

items.title: AI Website Chatbots
items.summary: A chatbot that answers real questions, on your site, any time someone's looking.
items.overview: A lot of enquiries happen outside office hours, or get lost because nobody was free to answer the phone. A well-built chatbot answers the common questions immediately and hands the rest to you — it doesn't try to replace a real conversation, just cover the gap.
benefits: Enquiries answered outside of business hours
Fewer repetitive questions landing in your inbox
Leads captured and handed to you, not lost
whatsIncluded: Chatbot setup trained on your actual services and FAQs
Lead capture and handoff to email or your booking system
Ongoing tuning as new questions come in

process.title: Train
process.description: The chatbot is set up using your actual services, pricing structure, and common customer questions — not a generic script.

process.title: Launch
process.description: It goes live on your site, handling repetitive questions and capturing leads outside office hours.

process.title: Refine
process.description: We review real conversations and tune it monthly so it keeps improving.

faqs.question: Will it give customers wrong information?
faqs.answer: It's trained specifically on your business and kept within clear boundaries — if it doesn't know something, it hands off rather than guessing.

faqs.question: Can it book appointments directly?
faqs.answer: Depending on your existing booking system, yes — otherwise it captures the enquiry and hands it straight to you.
